Package com.protonmail.landrevillejf.swingide.update.notifications

Class UpdateNotificationManager

java.lang.Object
com.protonmail.landrevillejf.swingide.update.notifications.UpdateNotificationManager
public class UpdateNotificationManager extends Object
Manages system notifications for update events using platform-native APIs. Supports Windows (balloon tips), macOS (Notification Center), and Linux (D-Bus notifications).

Every method is safe to call when no system tray is available (headless environments, window managers without a notification area): the notification is then simply logged and dropped.

    • removeTray

      public void removeTray()
      Remove tray icon and cleanup resources.

      This method never blocks its caller. SystemTray.remove disposes an AWT window and, when it is invoked from any thread other than the event dispatch thread, AWT waits for the EDT to process the disposal. A shutdown hook doing that while the EDT is itself inside System.exit - which joins every hook - deadlocks and the JVM never terminates. The removal is therefore posted to the EDT instead of being awaited, while the local state is cleared immediately so the tray is considered gone from now on.
